title: QlikView Failures by Task
app: QlikView Publisher/Distribution Service and Directory Service Connector logs via UF.
spl:
index=bi sourcetype=qlikview:distribution result="Failed"
| stats count as failures, latest(_time) as last_failure by task_name
| where failures>0
| sort - failures
description: Counts QlikView failures grouped by task so operators immediately see which specific tasks are broken rather than a single global failure number.
value: Object-level failure attribution turns a vague 'QlikView is failing' alert into an actionable list of exactly what to fix first.
implementation: Ingest QlikView failure events; schedule every 15 minutes and alert on failures for business-critical tasks.
visualization: Table of task by failure count and last failure time.
grandmaExplanation: We tell you exactly which parts of QlikView are failing, not just that something is wrong, so the right thing gets fixed first.
